title: Patient and support participants
work: Obtain goals, observations and applicable representation facts through permitted interaction.
merge_rationale: Represent related participants in one case model, with separate identities and statement attribution; do not replace them with a worker that supplies convenient answers.
retained_boundary: Patient choice, caregiver observation and lawful representation are different facts. Family relationship does not establish decision authority.
split_trigger: A merged record attributes caregiver wishes to the patient or treats missing consent as agreement.

title: Advocacy and assistance interfaces
work: Clarify complaints, access barriers and permitted representative assistance.
merge_rationale: Shared navigation and document-preparation capability may support several functions, while appointments and authority remain explicit.
retained_boundary: Appeal appointment is distinct from treatment representation; assistance is not insurer or adjudicator decision power.
split_trigger: One general advocate label silently grants authority over every dispute or patient decision.

title: Language and communication support
work: Support oral/written communication without changing the substantive author or decision owner.
merge_rationale: One language service can expose separate interpretation and translation operations; a persistent autonomous persona is not inherently needed.
retained_boundary: Written fidelity, oral turn-taking, participant comprehension and substantive consent must remain distinguishable. Qualification is not proved by a language prompt.
split_trigger: Translation drops a negation, invents an answer, or is recorded as informed understanding without evidence.

title: Treating-team and clinical-evidence interfaces
work: Request and attribute existing clinical assessments, orders, referral context and externally produced evidence.
merge_rationale: A shared evidence-request adapter may serve these contacts; that is an interface merger, not one interchangeable clinical occupation.
retained_boundary: Credential, jurisdiction, privileges, authorship and treating relationship remain distinct; reading a chart is not performing treatment or acquiring prescribing authority.
split_trigger: The harness fabricates a clinician statement or treats every clinical title as equivalent signatory permission.

title: Provider access and authorization operations
work: Identify the case, check administrative requirements, assemble supported materials, submit, track and coordinate scheduling/access barriers.
merge_rationale: These operations can share a case record and an accountable workflow owner; combining them may reduce summary handoffs.
retained_boundary: Identity, coverage verification, authorization outcome, financial estimate and service booking are different states. Management rank does not confer clinical power.
split_trigger: Measured merged execution repeatedly confuses administrative states, loses obligations or lacks genuinely different access scopes.

title: Records, coding and documentation support
work: Retrieve authentic records and identify coding/documentation questions with source attribution.
merge_rationale: A bounded evidence-preparation capability can combine retrieval and consistency checks without multiple autonomous writers.
retained_boundary: Record release, coding interpretation, clinical clarification and authentication are distinct. Staff must not create unsupported clinical facts.
split_trigger: A merged evidence worker silently repairs a clinical fact instead of requesting clarification or preserving uncertainty.

title: Provider dispute preparation and clinical exchange
work: Assemble the correct challenge and preserve clinical contributions and process status.
merge_rationale: Administrative filing preparation and evidence collection may share a workflow; clinical peer participation remains an explicitly authorized interface.
retained_boundary: Peer discussion is not automatically formal appeal; filing, clinical argument, appointment, deadline and acceptance are separate.
split_trigger: A merged job claims a successful appeal from a peer-discussion note or submits an unattributed clinical opinion.

title: Payer intake, benefits and status operations
work: Establish administrative context, collect information, route work and communicate observed status.
merge_rationale: A common payer case owner can combine collection and service/status functions with role-scoped operations.
retained_boundary: Limited delegated nonclinical decisions are program-specific; medical-necessity denial and general benefits/status work remain different permissions.
split_trigger: Status communication becomes an invented determination, or a clinically complete review is forced after a valid administrative terminal path.

title: Initial review and specialty reasoning
work: Evaluate applicable criteria and evidence, request needed specialty input, and propose only authorized case actions.
merge_rationale: Shared policy/evidence machinery can serve distinct review modes; separate bounded reasoning calls may be useful for genuinely different questions.
retained_boundary: Professional expertise, delegation, recommendation versus determination, and actual signoff remain separate. R13 signoff tension is unresolved; delegation may exclude appeals.
split_trigger: A shared review mode crosses product/delegation limits, hides conflicting evidence or requires more independent expertise than its input supports.

title: Notice preparation and delivery
work: Render and deliver the observed authorized decision with the appropriate reason and review information.
merge_rationale: This can be a controlled operation of the payer workflow owner rather than another open-ended agent.
retained_boundary: The notice must derive from the authoritative decision/version; drafting or delivery must not change the substantive decision.
split_trigger: Notice text contradicts the stored decision, wrong recipient is used, or draft is recorded as delivered.

title: Internal appeal administration and reconsideration
work: Establish standing/route, assemble the appeal record and obtain the applicable reconsideration outcome.
merge_rationale: Filing support may share software, but do not collapse initial-decision ownership and a required uninvolved reconsideration function.
retained_boundary: For the cited MA rule, actual uninvolved persons and appropriate physician expertise are requirements; a fresh LLM context is not proof of those human qualifications.
split_trigger: The initial author self-certifies independent reconsideration merely by changing its role label.

title: External review and adjudication interfaces
work: Identify the applicable external route, transmit authorized material, and observe externally issued outcomes.
merge_rationale: A routing adapter can share transport/record plumbing, while preserving distinct institutions, jurisdiction, eligibility and decision authority.
retained_boundary: MA IRE, commercial IRO, regulator, ALJ, Council and court are not one escalating internal worker. External decisions cannot be invented by a local reviewer persona.
split_trigger: A harness creates a binding external reversal or moves automatically through every forum without eligibility.

title: Care coordination and follow-through
work: Maintain goals, assessment context, referrals, outreach, barriers and observed follow-through across care transitions.
merge_rationale: A case owner can combine administrative coordination, navigation and general education support while invoking specific expertise when needed.
retained_boundary: Clinical assessment permissions, patient statements, discharge authority and professional education scope remain explicit; coordination is not physical service delivery.
split_trigger: A merged worker loses patient dialogue state, invents assessment answers, or marks a referral as completed care.

title: Psychosocial and behavioral-health interfaces
work: Identify psychosocial needs and interpret or request appropriate specialist contributions.
merge_rationale: Common intake/resource-finding support can be shared; separate expertise and restricted information views may be necessary for specialist reasoning.
retained_boundary: Job title, independent clinical licensure and additional prescribing certification differ. Do not collapse social support, therapy and prescribing.
split_trigger: A generic behavioral-health persona acts beyond its assigned function or exposes protected material to unrelated work.

title: Medication review and access
work: Distinguish medication expertise, existing therapy instructions and administrative access/fulfillment work.
merge_rationale: Share a medication evidence record and access workflow, while separating clinical proposals from technician/access operations.
retained_boundary: Protocol-authorized pharmacist activity, general prescribing and technician tasks are not equivalent; local authority is unresolved.
split_trigger: Medication availability is treated as a treatment order or access staff alter therapy.

title: Rehabilitation, nutrition and respiratory interfaces
work: Request or summarize discipline-specific assessments and service needs.
merge_rationale: Use a common referral/evidence adapter with discipline-specific capability selection; persistent workers only if workload and errors justify them.
retained_boundary: Different disciplines assess different functions and have different scope; one capability catalogue is not interchangeable clinical expertise.
split_trigger: A general specialist output substitutes nutrition, mobility, daily-function, communication or respiratory evidence for one another.

title: Receiving services and real-world fulfillment
work: Coordinate service acceptance, availability, scheduling and observed delivery/attendance evidence.
merge_rationale: A shared logistics coordinator can manage requests; providers, workers and actual delivery remain distinct external parties/events.
retained_boundary: Referral sent, accepted, scheduled, delivered and completed are separate states. Capacity and actual attendance must come from allowed observations.
split_trigger: A dispatcher persona or optimistic plan is used as evidence that a person received care, transport, food or equipment.

title: Hospice and spiritual-care interfaces
work: Coordinate the appropriate hospice group/attending and spiritual support contributions.
merge_rationale: Common communication plumbing may connect participants; the composite hospice profile must be decomposed into functions before creating worker identities.
retained_boundary: IDG planning, designated RN coordination, attending, certification/admission and spiritual support are distinct; the cited hospice evidence is the 2025 edition.
split_trigger: One hospice agent is assigned all professional decisions or spiritual support is treated as clinical certification.

title: Safeguarding and protection interface
work: Recognize a potential protection concern and follow an actually applicable reporting/escalation pathway.
merge_rationale: Detection and routing can be a capability of a case owner; legal investigation/protection authority remains external.
retained_boundary: Applicable mandate, jurisdiction, urgency and APS phase-in facts cannot be inferred from a generic concern. Child/adult pathways are not identical.
split_trigger: A model resolves a safeguarding case by assertion or invents a universal reporting rule.

title: Policy, legal and clinical governance
work: Establish applicable policies, approved versions and unresolved governance/legal questions.
merge_rationale: Share policy retrieval and change tracking; proposal, clinical governance, committee approval and legal advice remain separately attributed functions.
retained_boundary: An analyst draft or agent-generated rule is not approved policy. Provider and payer leaders have different mandates; hierarchy is not global authority.
split_trigger: A task worker rewrites the controlling rule or approves its own policy revision to make a case pass.

title: Management, quality, analytics and learning
work: Manage process design, training, workload and aggregate quality analysis outside ordinary case execution.
merge_rationale: A design-time analysis service may cover several functions, while runtime checks remain bounded and separate from official grading.
retained_boundary: Operational management is not clinical or appeal authority; internal diagnostics must not read hidden verifier answers or masquerade as official scores.
split_trigger: Training feedback contaminates held-out evaluation, or a self-audit is reported as independent official success.

title: Privacy and system-access controls
work: Constrain record access, authorized operations and technical identity/support.
merge_rationale: Prefer explicit permission/configuration machinery plus escalation where uncertain; a persona alone cannot enforce access.
retained_boundary: Technical access is not consent, clinical permission or substantive authorship; privacy purpose and special restrictions remain explicit.
split_trigger: Every worker receives all tools/data because one shared model is assumed to have global authority.

title: Billing and post-service account interface
work: Track account/claim status and administrative payment questions when actually in scope.
merge_rationale: Share identifiers and authorized documents with access/dispute workflows; invoke payment reasoning only where needed.
retained_boundary: Prior authorization, benefit verification, claim acceptance, adjudication and payment are different states.
split_trigger: Authorization success is reported as a paid claim or a completed financial outcome without evidence.
